title: Listen: Food, shopping and quantities
summary: Listen for two key details about food, shopping and quantities.

steps.fr: Je prends un sachet de lentilles et deux barquettes de fraises. Le prix des fraises est au kilo.
steps.question: How many strawberry punnets does the speaker take?

steps.fr: Du lait végétal ? J'en prends un litre. La boisson sans sucre reste au magasin.
steps.question: How much plant-based milk does the speaker take?
steps.explain: The quantity kept after en is un litre.
